items.title: CloudOrbit launches Monday June 15, 2026
items.body:
The first stable build of CloudOrbit now drops on **Monday June 15** — we held the Friday slot one more weekend so the SSO + kubeconfig path could get a final pass against real corporate proxies. Same launch day as WattsOrbit.

- AWS SSO session manager, no terminal needed
- Auto-updates kubeconfig as you switch profiles
- Detects EKS clusters from your active session
- Works behind Cloudflare and corporate proxies

Free, native Rust binary. Sign up to get notified the moment it ships.
